About the Ciclovía de Bogotá group ride

Ciclovía de Bogotá is an open-streets program in Bogotá, Colombia: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs every Sunday from 7:00 am local time.

The oldest recreational Ciclovía in the world, run by the city's sports institute. About 141 km of connected streets close to cars every Sunday and holiday morning. The IDRD says more than 1.5 million people use it each week.
